turns.user: why does my plan put protein in every single meal? can't I just have a big steak at dinner and be done
turns.reply:
Eating a big steak at dinner is great, but your body can only use 30 to 40 grams of protein at a time to trigger muscle protein synthesis for repair and recovery.

Dumping 130 grams into one meal means a lot gets oxidized for energy instead, so spreading it out keeps that repair process switched on and keeps you fuller all day! 🥩
